items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And then he finally persuaded Mr. Brown, Burton Brown, to put the bass on.

ctx.x: When did you go into the Gaslight Club?

I went into the Gaslight Club shortly after that. I went in there to make an album with Joe Kelly. And then he finally persuaded Mr. Brown, Burton Brown, to put the bass on. So that's when I started at the Gaslight.
